title: GTA 6 cops are way smarter than GTA 5 #gta6 #shorts
description: GTA 6 police track face, clothing, vehicle and CCTV (GamesRadar, Beebom).

scenes.say: The cops in GTA 6 are a whole different level.
Six stars instead of five. Cops can track your outfit and your car, and there's even an icon when CCTV catches you.
So switching outfits actually matters now.
Does that make it harder, or more fun?
